# Check If It Is a Straight Line.

@example From (-2,7), every 2 steps right go 3 down, through (0,4) and on to (4,-2); the list need not follow that order.
[[-2,7],[4,-2],[0,4]]
=> true

@example The first two points lie on the vertical line x = 3, and (4,2) does not.
[[3,0],[3,5],[4,2]]
=> false

@example Any two different points lie on a line.
[[5,-1],[-3,6]]
=> true

# A horizontal line across the whole box.
[[-10000,3],[10000,3],[0,3],[17,3]]
=> true

# A vertical line: a slope dy / dx would divide by zero. The first point
# is in the middle, with points above it and below it.
[[-6,42],[-6,10000],[-6,-10000],[-6,0]]
=> true

# A horizontal first pair, and the third point one row below it.
[[7,-2],[-5,-2],[1,-3],[0,-2]]
=> false

# A vertical first pair, and the last point one column off.
[[8,1],[8,-4],[8,9],[8,0],[9,3]]
=> false

# A slanted first pair; the third point shares the first one's x but not
# its line.
[[2,1],[5,7],[2,9]]
=> false

# Slopes 3/2 and 4/4 both round down to 1 in integer division.
[[0,0],[2,3],[4,4]]
=> false

# Slopes 1/3 and 0/6 both round down to 0.
[[0,0],[3,1],[6,0]]
=> false

# Slopes 19999/20000 and 19998/19999 differ by about 2.5e-9: a float, or a
# loose tolerance, takes them as equal.
[[-10000,-10000],[10000,9999],[9999,9998]]
=> false

# Slopes 19998/19999 and 19997/19998 also differ by about 2.5e-9, and they
# agree to seven decimal places: slopes rounded to a fixed number of
# decimals look equal.
[[10000,10000],[-9999,-9998],[-9998,-9997]]
=> false

# The full diagonal of the box, out of order.
[[10000,10000],[-10000,-10000],[0,0],[9999,9999],[-1,-1]]
=> true

# Points on both sides of the first one: from it, some lie in direction
# (3,-2) and some in direction (-3,2).
[[0,0],[3,-2],[-6,4],[9,-6],[-3,2]]
=> true

# The last point mirrors the on-line point (-1,-2) in the line y = 1: from
# the first point, the two products of the cross-product test are equal in
# size but opposite in sign.
[[1,1],[3,4],[5,7],[-1,-2],[-1,4]]
=> false

# Only the last point is off the line.
[[-4,13],[2,-5],[0,1],[-2,7],[4,-11],[6,-16]]
=> false

# Only the third point is off the line.
[[1,4],[3,8],[0,3],[5,12],[-2,-2]]
=> false

# Three corners of the box.
[[10000,-10000],[-10000,10000],[10000,10000]]
=> false

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 2 small
[[3,4],[1,1],[-3,-5]]
=> true

@gen 4 small
[[5,-6],[6,-1],[5,-1],[-2,6],[0,1]]
=> false

@gen 6 small
[[3,6],[3,1],[4,-6]]
=> false

@gen 8 small
[[-8859,7892],[-3044,7658],[-9355,7912]]
=> false

@gen 10 small
[[-2,-4],[-5,-6],[4,0],[1,-2]]
=> true

@gen 11 small
[[-5,-1],[-5,-6],[-5,5],[-5,-4],[-5,6],[-5,-2]]
=> true

@gen 15 small
[[6,-6],[-1,-6],[-2,-6],[-6,-6],[-3,-6],[2,-5]]
=> false

@gen 16 small
[[9321,3123],[9471,3359],[5853,-2320]]
=> false
